text: Build the first layer of the cohesive spec again (decision 3C, BRIEF.md addendum '2026-10-17: Olympus'): docs/spec.toml covering BRIEF.md 'Project Olympus' sections 1 to 6 (vision, pantheon, feedback, the example, the two loops, R1 to R8), with an xtask test. Each requirement has an id, a plain cohesive statement, a kind (goal, requirement, constraint or acceptance), a status (active or superseded), and one or more sources, each a verbatim quote with its heading; duplicates merge into one requirement with several sources; a conflict or open choice in Sri's words is recorded as an open question quoting both, never resolved. The test fails on a quote that is not a verbatim substring of BRIEF.md (whitespace collapsed), a duplicate id, a supersedes target that does not exist, or a requirement without a source, with in-memory negative cases, and finds at least one requirement for each of R1 to R8 and sections 1 to 5. No statement about who runs Athena or where (xtask/tests/policy.rs). Record the format and the choice of TOML in docs/decisions.md; sections 7 to 10, the governing philosophy and the 2026-10-17 addenda follow in a second job. Job 20261018-145008-k7fq built this once, but it reached main only through a hand merge that was reverted (2a86df5), so it is built again here.
